subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like tool failures with `includeDetails` be suppressed before mutating-tool warning handling, or should cron, heartbeat, full-verbose, and mutating exec detail warnings remain visible?
rationale: Current tests intentionally show several exec detail warnings, while the PR and linked issue request suppressing exec-like warnings regardless of `includeDetails`; automation cannot safely rewrite that user-visible policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Confirm Suppress-All Exec Policy
options.body: Move exec-like suppression ahead of mutating handling and update focused tests so `includeDetails` does not make exec-like warnings visible.

options.title: Preserve Detail Warning Contract
options.body: Keep cron, heartbeat, full-verbose, and unresolved mutating exec warnings visible and narrow the linked issue to only the intended non-mutating path.

recommendation.title: Confirm Suppress-All Exec Policy
recommendation.body: Move exec-like suppression ahead of mutating handling and update focused tests so `includeDetails` does not make exec-like warnings visible.
